body: Closing a company, saves time and money on annual filings. We apply for dissolution to Companies House to strike it off the register of companies. Once the dissolution process is over, the company no longer exists. At Brixen Consultants, you can avail the best company dissolution service from our expert professionals. Dissolution issues may arise due to many reasons, the shareholders may decide to retire the assets as well as the goodwill of a company that will be sold to a new owner. Voluntary dissolution is called striking a company off or winding a company up. This is basically a slow process that takes much time and effort. But with the experts like us, you don’t need to bear any hassle and can accomplish the task easily without facing any hurdles.

Submitting a company dissolution to the company house is not an easy task, every information needs to be checked and verified before submission. We send you the Board Resolution copy in email within 5hrs. for you sign it electronically and submit. After we receive the submission, we file and process it to the Company House. Once the entire process is completed, you get an email with the information that the company is dissolved. You also receive a letter from the Company House at your registered office address. Most of the companies need to rely on trusted partners to facilitate the entire process. While going through the process of dissolution, you need to take proper steps to protect your shareholders. At the Brixen Consultants, we ensure that your dissolution process is done quickly and correctly without facing any issues.
